description.value: The Art We Are began in August 2008 as a local art gallery and evolved into a cafe while keeping rotating works by local artists on its walls and shelves. It serves a freshly made menu of brunch wraps, house soups (rotating daily with at least one always vegan and GF), wraps, sandwiches, and desserts—with ingredients sourced as locally as possible. Touring cyclists will find strong gluten-free and vegan options throughout the menu, and the cafe also offers catering with delivery for group orders.

bike_parking_detail: 8 racks within 100m: rack (1 space) at 13m; rack (1 space) at 56m; rack (5 spaces) at 57m; rack (1 space) at 66m; rack (5 spaces) at 74m; rack (1 space) at 82m; rack (5 spaces) at 82m; rack (1 space) at 98m. Total: 20 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates the OSM contact details (phone, address, name) and confirms an active, diverse cafe menu with extensive gluten-free and vegan offerings across brunch, soups, wraps, and desserts—matching OSM's diet tags exactly. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, device charging, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those remain null. The business has a clear downtown Kamloops location and is demonstrably open and operating.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established downtown Kamloops cafe with a broad menu featuring strong vegan and gluten-free options, making it a practical and welcoming stop for touring cyclists of diverse dietary needs.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email address theartweare@gmail.com is present on the website but not in OSM tags; could be added to the OSM record.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website food menu lists multiple vegan items (Vegan Brunch Wrap, Thai Wrap, Falafel Wrap, vegan soups, vegan muffins), multiple GF items (Vegetable Quiche with yam crust, GF Bacon Brunch Muffin, GF Veggie Brunch Muffin, GF/vegan cornbread, GF/vegan muffins), and many vegetarian options. Catering page also confirms 'tons of gluten free and vegan choices.'
